Name: Audrey - New Custom NPC
Author: TL0TD
Description:
[url=https://tlotd.net/][img]https://tlotd.net/assets/projects/made_by_tlotd.png[/img][/url] [url=https://isla-nublar.com/][img]https://tlotd.net/assets/projects/made_by_isla_nublar.png[/img][/url]
In the backwoods above the old farm lies a mountain cottage. Living inside is the kind and curious Audrey. She and her grandmother arrived in Pelican Town when she was just a little girl. After her grandmothes death Willy took on the mantle of raising her, he took her fishing and told her stories about the sea.

She's marriageable with her own custom cottage, where she resides, a custom spouse room , winter sprites, event dialouges & a (for now limited) schedule.

[b]Installation:
[/b]- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Place in your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder

[color=#D4D4D8][b]Requires[/b]:
- [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ [/color]

[b]Notes:
[/b]- Birthday: Spring 9
- Loves: Cactus Fruit, Coconut, Complete Breakfast, Duck Feather, Fish Taco, Golden Pearl, Golden Pumpkin, Hazelnut, Maple Bar, Maple Syrup, Pancakes, Pearl, Piña Colada, Roasted Hazelnuts, Sunflower, Tortilla.

Downloads.Description: The only thing that is not made by me but just edited are the portraits from the portrait maker by Jazzybee and Poltergeist aswell as a edited version of Sandy's spring outfit from Slightly Cuter Aesthetic by Poltergeister.
